scenarios.title: National bourbon shortage
scenarios.story: A bottling line outage cut Harbor Ridge output. The plant can fill about 58% of open orders, and the next run lands in 6 weeks. Some markets are nearly dry while others are sitting on plenty.

scenarios.title: One market long, another short
scenarios.story: Summit Crest bought heavily into Texas ahead of a promotion that slipped, leaving about 140 days on hand there while its Florida market is nearly out. An intracompany transfer can fix Florida faster than the plant can.

scenarios.title: Holiday sparkling crunch
scenarios.story: Holiday demand for North Shore Brut came in well above plan. Supply covers about 55% of orders until the next run in 4 weeks, and two national-account markets are close to stocking out.
